+import csv
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PARQUET = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute("CREATE VIEW crashes AS SELECT crash_date, borough, number_of_pedestrians_injured, number_of_pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet(?)", [str(PARQUET)])
+
+facts_by_plan = {1: [], 2: []}
+
+
+def add(fact, value):
+    for values in facts_by_plan.values():
+        values.append({"fact": fact, "value": value})
+
+
+scope = "crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'"
+all_years = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS yr,
+           count(*) AS city_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn') AS brooklyn_rows,
+           min(crash_date) AS first_date,
+           max(crash_date) AS last_date
+    FROM crashes WHERE {scope}
+    GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr
+    """
+).fetchall()
+add("Candidate population definition", "All rows with a nonmissing crash_date in 2013 or later; borough and outcome quality summarized separately")
+candidate_n = con.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE {scope}").fetchone()[0]
+add("Candidate dated NYC crash rows (2013 onward)", candidate_n)
+add("Rows with missing crash_date (cannot assign to a planned year)", con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE crash_date IS NULL").fetchone()[0])
+
+valid_boroughs = "('BRONX', 'BROOKLYN', 'MANHATTAN', 'QUEENS', 'STATEN ISLAND')"
+borough_stats = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT
+      count(*) FILTER (WHERE borough IS NULL OR trim(borough) = '' OR upper(trim(borough)) IN ('UNKNOWN','UNSPECIFIED','N/A','NA','NONE')) AS missing_or_unknown,
+      count(*) FILTER (WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND trim(borough) <> '' AND upper(trim(borough)) NOT IN {valid_boroughs} AND upper(trim(borough)) NOT IN ('UNKNOWN','UNSPECIFIED','N/A','NA','NONE')) AS unsupported_value,
+      count(*) FILTER (WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn') AS brooklyn_rows
+    FROM crashes WHERE {scope}
+    """
+).fetchone()
+add("Borough missing/blank/unknown/sentinel rows in dated candidate population", borough_stats[0])
+add("Borough unsupported-value rows in dated candidate population", borough_stats[1])
+add("Brooklyn rows in dated candidate population", borough_stats[2])
+add("Share of dated candidate rows with missing/unknown borough", borough_stats[0] / candidate_n if candidate_n else None)
+add("Share of dated candidate rows with unsupported borough", borough_stats[1] / candidate_n if candidate_n else None)
+
+for year, city_rows, brooklyn_rows, first_date, last_date in all_years:
+    start = f"{year}-01-01"
+    end = f"{year}-12-31"
+    partial = str(first_date) > start or str(last_date) < end
+    add(f"{year}: NYC candidate rows", city_rows)
+    add(f"{year}: Brooklyn rows before outcome completeness filter", brooklyn_rows)
+    add(f"{year}: observed date coverage", f"{first_date} through {last_date}")
+    add(f"{year}: partial calendar year in file", "yes" if partial else "no")
+
+    outcome_stats = con.execute(
+        """
+        SELECT count(*) AS brooklyn_rows,
+          count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NULL) AS pedestrian_injured_missing,
+          count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL) AS pedestrian_killed_missing,
+          count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NULL OR number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL) AS either_outcome_missing
+        FROM crashes
+        WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn' AND year(crash_date) = ?
+        """,
+        [year],
+    ).fetchone()
+    add(f"{year}: Brooklyn rows with missing number_of_pedestrians_injured", outcome_stats[1])
+    add(f"{year}: Brooklyn rows with missing number_of_pedestrians_killed", outcome_stats[2])
+    add(f"{year}: Brooklyn rows missing either pedestrian outcome field", outcome_stats[3])
+    add(f"{year}: Brooklyn rows with both pedestrian outcome fields present", outcome_stats[0] - outcome_stats[3])
+
+for plan_id, rows in facts_by_plan.items():
+    path = OUT / f"check_{plan_id}.csv"
+    with path.open("w", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["fact", "value"])
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+
+    plan_path = OUT / f"plan_{plan_id}.json"
+    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
+    years = [row[0] for row in all_years]
+    partial_years = [
+        row[0]
+        for row in all_years
+        if str(row[3]) > f"{row[0]}-01-01" or str(row[4]) < f"{row[0]}-12-31"
+    ]
+    plan["data_check_decisions"] = {
+        "facts_file": f"check_{plan_id}.csv",
+        "observed_years": years,
+        "partial_calendar_years": partial_years,
+        "borough_decision": "Keep only borough exactly recorded as Brooklyn; missing, unknown, and unsupported borough labels cannot be assigned to Brooklyn and are excluded. Their counts and shares are in the check file.",
+        "outcome_decision": "Exclude Brooklyn crash rows with a missing value in any outcome field used by this framing; do not treat missing counts as zero. Counts omitted are reported per year in the check file.",
+        "year_decision": "Exclude any calendar year with partial date coverage from the chart; retain complete calendar years beginning in 2013.",
+        "population_after_checks": "Brooklyn crashes in complete calendar years from 2013 onward with all required outcome fields present.",
+    }
+    plan["limitations"] = "The file reports crash counts, not pedestrian exposure or population, so absolute annual casualty counts do not measure risk per trip or establish overall road safety. Borough labels not recorded exactly as Brooklyn are excluded; crashes missing required pedestrian outcome counts are excluded rather than assumed to have zero outcomes. Partial calendar years are excluded. See the check file for counts and date coverage."
+    final = plan["initial_plan"].copy()
+    final["years"] = f"Complete calendar years from 2013 through {max(year for year in years if year not in partial_years)}; exclude partial years {partial_years}."
+    final["population"] = "Brooklyn crashes in the final complete calendar years with nonmissing values for all pedestrian outcome fields used; count the recorded pedestrian outcomes from those crashes."
+    final["data_check_decisions"] = plan["data_check_decisions"]
+    final["limitations"] = plan["limitations"]
+    plan["final_plan"] = final
+    plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+con.close()
*** End Patch

+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PARQUET = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+parquet_literal = str(PARQUET).replace("'", "''")
+con.execute(
+    "CREATE VIEW crashes AS SELECT crash_date, borough, number_of_pedestrians_injured, number_of_pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet('"
+    + parquet_literal
+    + "')"
+)
+
+for plan_id in (1, 2):
+    plan = json.loads((OUT / f"plan_{plan_id}.json").read_text())["final_plan"]
+    year_start, year_end = 2013, 2025
+    year_clause = f"year(crash_date) BETWEEN {year_start} AND {year_end}"
+    borough_clause = "upper(trim(borough)) = 'BROOKLYN'"
+
+    if plan_id == 1:
+        query = f"""
+        SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+               sum(number_of_pedestrians_injured) AS pedestrian_injuries,
+               sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_deaths,
+               sum(number_of_pedestrians_injured + number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_casualties
+        FROM crashes
+        WHERE {borough_clause} AND {year_clause}
+          AND number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NOT NULL
+          AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NOT NULL
+        GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
+        """
+        title = "Recorded pedestrian casualties in Brooklyn, 2013–2025"
+        y_label = "Recorded pedestrian injuries + deaths"
+        chart_type = "line chart"
+        value_column = "pedestrian_casualties"
+        color = "#176B87"
+        chart_file = OUT / "option_1.png"
+    else:
+        query = f"""
+        SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+               sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_deaths
+        FROM crashes
+        WHERE {borough_clause} AND {year_clause}
+          AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NOT NULL
+        GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
+        """
+        title = "Recorded pedestrian deaths in Brooklyn, 2013–2025"
+        y_label = "Recorded pedestrian deaths"
+        chart_type = "bar chart"
+        value_column = "pedestrian_deaths"
+        color = "#B24C3D"
+        chart_file = OUT / "option_2.png"
+
+    frame = con.execute(query).fetchdf()
+    expected_years = list(range(year_start, year_end + 1))
+    if frame["year"].astype(int).tolist() != expected_years:
+        raise ValueError(f"Plan {plan_id} does not have exactly one result for every retained year")
+    frame["year"] = frame["year"].astype(int)
+    frame.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{plan_id}.csv", index=False)
+
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.4, 5.8), layout="constrained")
+    if plan_id == 1:
+        ax.plot(frame["year"], frame[value_column], color=color, linewidth=2.8, marker="o", markersize=5.5)
+        ax.fill_between(frame["year"], frame[value_column], color=color, alpha=0.10)
+    else:
+        bars = ax.bar(frame["year"], frame[value_column], color=color, width=0.68)
+        ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=8, color="#4b5563")
+
+    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", fontsize=17, weight="bold", pad=22)
+    ax.text(
+        0,
+        1.035,
+        "Annual counts from police-reported crashes; not adjusted for pedestrian exposure. Partial 2026 omitted.",
+        transform=ax.transAxes,
+        fontsize=9.5,
+        color="#555555",
+    )
+    ax.set_xlabel("Crash year", fontsize=10)
+    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=10)
+    ax.set_xticks(expected_years)
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45, labelsize=8.5)
+    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=9)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#d9dfe3", linewidth=0.8)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#aab2b7")
+    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#aab2b7")
+    fig.text(0.01, 0.005, "Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes; counts are reported cases, not unique people linked across crashes.", fontsize=8, color="#555555")
+    fig.savefig(chart_file, dpi=180, facecolor="white")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+con.close()
